product_wide_rationale: Defines pre-readiness development authority, amended by CD-0089 for self-hosting and CD-0213 for planning and issue linkage. It governs how the Product is built rather than one runtime Domain.
summary: Defines development authority: Linear MCP owns planning under CD-0213, pull requests and required checks own review and merge evidence, and priorities.md owns the development route for new assignments, work already underway, and authorized workflow-defect repair.
title: Pre-readiness development authority
